# WindowTitleBar

```ts
import { WindowTitleBar } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

The bar across the top of a window: app icon, title, and minimize / maximize / close. App windows normally use the hello pc topbar instead; use this for secondary windows without a topbar (variant="windows") and for floating in-app panels such as agent panels and pop-out editors (variant="in-app").

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'windows' \| 'in-app'` | `'windows'` | windows — the 32px Windows caption bar for secondary windows that have no topbar (transparent over Mica, 46×32 caption buttons). in-app — a 48px bar for floating agent panels and pop-out editors (container surface, bottom border, 32px icon buttons). Figma style. |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | The window title (usually the app or document name). |
| `appIcon` | `React.ReactNode` | — | App icon slot — 16px in windows, 20px in in-app. Decorative. |
| `onMinimize` | `() => void` | — | Shows the Minimize control and calls this when it's pressed. |
| `onMaximize` | `() => void` | — | Shows the Maximize/Restore control and calls this when it's pressed. |
| `onClose` | `() => void` | — | Shows the Close control and calls this when it's pressed. |
| `maximized` | `boolean` | `false` | The window is maximized: the control becomes Restore. |
| `dragRegion` | `boolean` | `true` | Marks the bar as the window's drag region (app-region: drag, with the controls excluded) for desktop hosts such as Electron or WebView2. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'title'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<WindowTitleBar title="Lenovo Vantage" appIcon={<AppIcon />} onMinimize={min} onMaximize={max} onClose={close} />
<WindowTitleBar title="Settings" onClose={close} />
<WindowTitleBar title="Report.docx" maximized onMaximize={restore} onClose={close} />
<WindowTitleBar variant="in-app" title="Assistant" appIcon={<AppIcon />} onClose={close} />
```

## Accessibility

- Every control is a real button with a name: "Minimize", "Maximize" / "Restore", "Close".
- The app icon is decorative; the title is the window's name.
- For an in-app panel, the panel itself (often a Dialog) should close on Esc and return focus to what opened it.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use the topbar for main app windows | Stack a title bar above a topbar |
| Show only the controls the window supports | Show a Maximize that does nothing |
| Keep titles short — the app or document name | Put status text or actions in the title |
